title: refactor(rest): move the /meta object state-machine read and the published read out of rest-server.ts (#23050 slice 13e)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Sub-slice **13e** of the `rest-server.ts` split, the last `/meta` sub-slice. The seventh and eighth groups of `RestServer#registerMetadataEndpointsInner` move out, each called at its old position:

| group | route | base range (`52ff308b8`, leading comments included) | moves to |
|---|---|---|---|
| G7 | `GET {metaPath}/object/:name/state/:field` (one direct register statement, in no per-family switch) | `rest-server.ts:5287`–`:5439` (statement `:5315`–`:5439`), 153 lines | new `packages/rest/src/meta-object-state-routes.ts`, `registerMetaObjectStateRoute` |
| G8 | `GET {metaPath}/:type/:name/published` (one bare block holding one per-item registration) | `rest-server.ts:5441`–`:5722` (block `:5466`–`:5722`), 282 lines | `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`, a second export `registerMetaItemPublishedRoute` |

This follows the slicing plan (`os-dev-report` `6239704287`, entry 13e), seat 1's ruling on it `6239783526`, static-receiver ruling A `6205442867`, the provider-getter ruling `6215084478`, 13d's `handover_13e` (report `6248737371`, binding where it measured) and the claim `6249541908`. PR #24304 (13d) is the shape copied.

Nothing else moves:
- the route table, the ordered server registrations, every server-visible handler and every INNER registration (method, path, metadata, arity, handler digest) are identical, base vs head, in 20 configurations;
- the published `dist/index.d.ts` / `index.d.cts` are byte-identical, and so are both bundles' 39-name export lists;
- one code token of the moved text changed, the ruled receiver in the published read (below); the state read's 153 lines are byte-identical after one indent level.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 6,575 to 6,196 lines (+70 / −449). The umbrella `registerMetadataEndpoints` and its guarded swap, the inner head's bindings and `registerPerItemRoute` itself (only its docblock's stale text is re-worded, below), every handler body, the class head and its members, `meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `docs/adr/**` and `packages/spec/src/**` are untouched.

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line above: this is a move. The route table, the inner registrations, every wire answer, the `.d.ts` and the export list stay identical (measured below), no declaration gained or lost an `export`, and the reader edits change evidence paths only.

## The rulings this follows

The maintainer's rule on this card, verbatim: 「每片只搬代码、路由表前后一致、门禁和文档锚点同 PR 迁完。」

Seat 1's ruling `6239783526`, verbatim in the parts that bind this slice:

> - **Q1, A.** The four head bindings (`metadata`, `metaPath`, `isScoped`, `registerPerItemRoute`) reach each module as ONE `scope: MetaRouteScope` parameter, built once in the inner head. Each module destructures only what it uses, and body tokens are unchanged. The host stays class members only.
>   - `registerPerItemRoute` stays one closure that reads RestServer's guarded `routeManager` at call time. ⛔ No module-local copy: that would be a second copy of a helper (rule 2).
> - **Q3, A.** `rest-server-registrar-files.ts` exports a named subset, the `/meta` modules. The dogfood census's reachable count becomes "the umbrella's sites plus every site in that subset", and a control pins the subset against the number of module calls inside the inner method. […]
>   - From 13c on, a module with no direct register site is controlled on `registerPerItemRoute(` instead.
>   - ⛔ No naming convention, and ⛔ never "let blindSpot rise".
> - **Hosts are built inside `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`**, at the position of the statements they replace, with `routeManager` passed by value. […]
> - **The proof gains an inner-registration leg.** […] A one-character positive control must move exactly that route's inner digest.

The provider-getter ruling `6215084478`: "A provider field keeps the getter shape, unbound, as slices 2–8 did."

## The shape

**Moved, at its positions.** Right after 13d's history call, the inner method now declares one arrow, `const readObjectQLProvider = () => this.objectQLProvider;` (what both getters below read), then builds `objectStateHost` and calls `registerMetaObjectStateRoute` with it, then builds `itemPublishedHost` and calls `registerMetaItemPublishedRoute` with it, each with the ONE existing `scope` (no second scope literal). Registration order is unchanged: history family, object state read, published read, then the tail comment on the retired compound twins.

**`MetaObjectStateRouteHost`, 3 members in first-read order** (a symbol-resolved walk with the TypeScript compiler API, slice 12's method; no bare `this`, no `this[...]`, no `function` keyword, no assignment to a `this` member):

| member | reads | handed over as |
|---|---:|---|
| `routeManager` | 1 (registration time, the one register statement) | BY VALUE, captured inside the inner method, so it is the umbrella's wrapping registrar |
| `objectQLProvider` | 2 (request time, through `wiredEngineOrLoud`) | GETTER onto the class's field (the provider-getter ruling) |
| `resolveProtocol` | 1 (the disabled-package refusal) | closure |

**`MetaItemPublishedRouteHost`, 7 members in first-read order, no `routeManager`** (13d's hand-off corrected the plan's 6):

| member | reads | handed over as |
|---|---:|---|
| `metaTypeSingular` (private static) | 1 | closure on the class, `(...a) => RestServer.metaTypeSingular(...a)` |
| `resolveObjectMasker` | 1 | closure |
| `resolveProtocol` | 2 | closure |
| `metaItemReadGate` | 1 | closure |
| `maskObjectDocument` | 1 | closure |
| `objectQLProvider` | 2 (request time, the disabled-owner check PR #24247 added) | GETTER |
| `resolveMetadataService` | 1 | closure |

The published read registers through `registerPerItemRoute`, which reaches the module in `scope` as the inner head's ONE closure (Q1 A, no module-local copy); it still reads the server's route manager at call time, inside the umbrella's swap, and still reads `metadata.endpoints.item`.

**The one ruled receiver token (ruling A `6205442867`):** `RestServer.metaTypeSingular(type)` became `this.metaTypeSingular(type)` in the published read. The static reads nothing but its argument.

**Module-level names.**
- `wiredEngineOrLoud` and the `RestProtocol` type stay in `rest-server.ts` and are imported from it (both read only at request time).
- **Imports that left `rest-server.ts` with the bodies (five, measured by `tsc --noEmit`'s `noUnusedLocals`):** `META_ITEM_PUBLISHED_PARAMS` (its re-export there stays), `canonicalMetaUrlType`, `relateObjectSchemaMaskPosture`, `refuseUnknownQueryParams` and `handleRouteError`. The plan named two; `refuseUnknownQueryParams` had the published read as its last reader in that file, and `handleRouteError` had exactly these two doors. A one-line pointer comment stands at each old position. `ObjectSchemaMaskEvaluationError` stays: the class head's `resolveObjectMasker` docblock links it, and both `tsc` and eslint count that use.
- The dynamic `import('@objectstack/objectql')` moved with the state read.

**Inner-head docblock.** The `registerPerItemRoute` docblock's two stale sentences (13d's out-of-scope note) now say where the per-item members live: the first four in the `if` block that moved to `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, the later ones registered by three calls in two modules, with the state read registered between the last two. The `.d.ts` does not carry it (it is inside the method body).

## Proof

Builds, suites, dumps, controls and ablations ran through `os-verify-lock`, every exit captured before any pipe; the short `tsx` probes ran unlocked (Deviations). Base is `52ff308b8` (the claim's). The move is `1ed1f29bc`; the registrar list grows at `7684c634e`; the readers are re-pointed at `7c625ffe7`; the changeset is `ea3f421d8`; `f2c84cc6f` merges `origin/main` `2b7fc52c3` (eight commits, no path in common with this diff, and `packages/rest` byte-identical across `52ff308b8..2b7fc52c3`).

**1. The moved text.** G7, base `:5287`–`:5439` against the module's body with one 4-space indent removed: identical over all 153 lines (sha256 `fbdd10f74c51…` both sides). G8, base `:5441`–`:5722` against `registerMetaItemPublishedRoute`'s body: the raw comparison differs on exactly one line (the receiver); with `this.metaTypeSingular(` mapped back it is identical over all 282 lines (sha256 `79f1e7c77c4f…` both sides). Every non-empty line carried the 8-space indent; no tab, no trailing whitespace.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports.** `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` are sha256 `e027d7941ba1908e…` at base, at `7c625ffe7` and at the merge head (byte-identical, `cmp` exit 0). Both bundles load with 39 exports and one sorted name list, sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…`, ESM == CJS, base and head. The head-only markers `registerMetaObjectStateRoute` and `registerMetaItemPublishedRoute` hit 2 each in `index.js` and `index.cjs` at head, 0 at base.

**3. Full-boot legs, 20 configurations** (slice 12's thirteen, plus the `/meta` switches under scoped-optional: `metadata.endpoints.types`, `.items`, `.item`, `.maintenance` each false, all four false, `metadata.prefix: '/metadata'`, `api.enableMetadata: false`):
- **Source leg** (a `tsx` boot of `src/rest-server.ts`): `routes.json`, `calls.json` and `handlers.json` byte-identical in all 20 configs, 60 of 60, concatenation sha256 `e73a487e4cfc05ab…`, at the move commit and at the merge head.
- **Bundle leg** (the same dump against the built `dist/index.js`, the base bundle loaded from a gitignored copy): 60 of 60 identical, concatenation `cd64ab2234f144bd…`, with no normalization.

**4. The inner-registration leg.** A recording `routeManager` and a direct `registerMetadataEndpointsInner(basePath)` call per base and per config: 688 recorded registrations, digested whitespace-free with the ruled receiver tokens of 13a–13e mapped back, together with method, path, metadata and arity.
- **Source leg:** 688 of 688 identical, same order. Raw, exactly 36 differ: `GET …/published` on both bases in the 18 configs that mount it, the receiver.
- **Bundle leg:** 688 of 688 identical under one declared normalization, esbuild's numeric alias suffix on two import names the published read's body spells, found by a token diff of that handler's bundled text: `ObjectSchemaMaskEvaluationError` (4 → 3) and `canonicalMetaUrlType` (3 → 2). The token diff shows exactly three changes in that handler, the receiver and those two aliases.
- **Positive controls** (one character each, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0): the state read's 501 message gained a `!` (module blob `58cd7759387a` → `0a91d9fe3459`): exactly 40 of 688 inner digests moved, that route on both bases in all 20 configs, and nowhere else. Then, separately, the published read's 501 message (module blob `5e850bcc6a62` → `6efca2bac7d6`): exactly 36 of 688 moved, that route only. All 20 configs' full-boot files stayed byte-identical (60 of 60) under both. Restored each time: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**5. H2: both routes still mount behind the umbrella's gate.** An anonymous request at each moved route on both bases (one-off `tsx` probe, scoped-optional), base and head output byte-identical (`diff` exit 0):
- `endpoints.item` on: all four mounts answer `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` with zero protocol calls and zero provider calls, and all four server-visible handlers are the umbrella's wrapper.
- `endpoints.item: false`: 150 → 126 routes; the two published mounts are gone and the two state mounts remain (the state read is in no per-family switch), still `401`.

**6. The guard ablation** (the plan's shapes for 13e-state and 13e-published, four nested `ablation-replace` anchors, none occurring inside its own replacement): the umbrella stashes its `realRouteManager` captured above the swap; `objectStateHost` carries THAT as its `routeManager` (13e-state); `itemPublishedHost` carries it too, and `registerMetaItemPublishedRoute` replaces the scope's registrar with a module-local one that honours the same switch but registers on that host member (13e-published).
- **Ablation:** the anonymous state request is SERVED (`200`, the provider called once) and the anonymous published request reaches the protocol (`501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, one protocol call); none of the four handlers is the wrapper. Under `endpoints.item: false` the published mounts are still gone.
- **Standing pins under the ablation:** `Test Files 2 failed | 5 passed (7)`, `Tests 17 failed | 135 passed (152)`: `meta-type-read-capability.test.ts` red 16 times (#21087, the `/published` read shape for the four datasource-family type spellings, for member, other-grant and author, plus each spelling's existing-vs-absent byte identity), and `meta-state-route-engine-outage.test.ts` red once ("the route is behind the anonymous-deny gate"), so the state read does have a standing anonymous pin (the plan read none). `rest-meta-auth.test.ts`, `meta-type-write-capability.test.ts`, `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`, `meta-route-registration-order.test.ts` and `meta-disabled-package-doors.test.ts` stay green.
- Restored, both files: each blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No permanent test was added.

**7. The late-binding ablation** (one-off script). The five instance methods and the provider field are planted on the server, and the static on the class, before `registerRoutes()`, as recorders; four request shapes are driven over the two moved routes, then everything is planted again and the shapes are driven again.
- **Head** (`MEASURE` lines byte-identical to base): all 7 members, the provider field included, are reached late after the re-plant, `early calls after re-plant: 0`.
- **Ablation (a), the getter:** `objectStateHost`'s getter turned into a value copied at host-build time gives `early calls after re-plant: 2 ["early:objectQLProvider"]`, exit 1.
- **Ablation (b), a closure:** `resolveMetadataService: this.resolveMetadataService.bind(this)` gives `early calls after re-plant: 2 ["early:resolveMetadataService"]`, exit 1.
- Restored after each: the blob equals `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

Still seventeen forwarders: (18 − 1) + 4 − 4, the published read counted as the history module's second registrar in `EXTRA_MOVED_REGISTRARS` and in `MOVED_REGISTRARS_READING_NO_EXECCTX` (the discovery module's precedent), the new module in the latter |

| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` | 70 / 19 / 51, unchanged | The state module's control `this.routeManager.register(` = 1; the history module's `registerPerItemRoute(` 5 → 6; whole-population `registerPerItemRoute(` stays 8 (0 + 2 + 6); `this.routeManager.register(` stays 63. **One control re-keyed, not relaxed:** the inner method now calls the history module twice, so `.call(` inside it reads 6 against a subset of 5 files; it is recorded as `REST_SERVER_META_ROUTE_FILES.length + 1`, so a `/meta` module called without joining the subset, or a subset entry no longer called, still moves it |

| `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__meta-object-state-routes.ts.json` (new) | decision letters 1783 → 1782 at the move → 1785 | The state read's `ADR-0020 D3.3` left the anchored surface silently; the anchor puts the module on it (its header, its moved body and the anchor's invariant each cite D3.3) |

## Tests and gates at the final head

At the final head `f2c84cc6f` (the merge), under `os-verify-lock`, every exit captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK — … 0 file(s) / 0 error(s)`).
- rest `local` (whole project): exit 0, `Test Files  295 passed (295)`, `Tests  6051 passed | 326 skipped (6377)` (436.87 s on a shared box).
- rest `repo` (this diff edits one of its tests): exit 0, `Test Files  5 passed (5)`, `Tests  278 passed | 18 skipped (296)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0. Dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` + `authz-conformance.test.ts`: exit 0, `Tests  108 passed (108)`.
- runtime `repo`, narrowed to `src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts` (the one runtime test that reads `rest-server.ts` from disk): exit 0, `Tests  739 passed (739)`. The rest of runtime's and core's `repo` projects are CI's (`Test Core`).

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) at `f2c84cc6f` derives 92 commands over this branch's 19 paths against merge base `2b7fc52c3` (1,444 changed lines, +942 / −502). All 92 ran sequentially: 92 exit 0. `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.` Readings: `check:route-envelope` 29 route modules (9 conformant, 19 ratcheted, 1 exempt); `check:adr-anchors` 75 anchored files, 1785 decision letters; `check-system-context-census` OK (142 sites, 136/136 symbols, 159 anchors); `check:undeclared-dep-imports` 1 ledger row, evidence intact; `check-issue-citations` 49 judged across 4 files, 48 resolve and 1 resolves as a pull request; `check:cross-package-test-inputs` OK; `check:nul-bytes` OK; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` 111 entry points across 69 packages. Beside the union: `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (10 anchors judged, 0 lost); `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 17 changed `.ts` / `.mjs` files, exit 0 with no output; `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD` exit 0, 0 of 19 paths governed. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

`origin/main` has since moved to `117301705` (#24319, #24317: `packages/adapters/hono`, `packages/platform-objects`), no path in common with this diff; not merged again.

## Acceptance notes

- The moved comments are moved text and keep their deixis ("here", "below", "the dispatcher branch this mirrors"); both module headers say so rather than editing moved text.
- `rest-server-audit-org-scope.test.ts:23` says "the `/published` route's comment in `rest-server.ts` records that inventing org plumbing … would be a smuggled seam". The published read's comment has not said that since its `[ADR-0131 D6]` paragraph replaced it, so the pointer was already dead before this move; not edited here, `carrier:` none.
- `packages/spec/liveness/metadata_endpoints.json`'s `endpoints.item` evidence says the inner method's `registerPerItemRoute` gates "the per-item PUT/DELETE and the history family"; still true of the gate (the closure stays in the inner head), and the published read now joins those call sites in `meta-item-history-routes.ts`. The spec seat's file, still resolving, not edited (13d's note, `carrier:` none).
- After this PR `registerMetadataEndpointsInner` is its head (the three bindings, `registerPerItemRoute` and the scope), six host literals with their six calls, and the tail comment on the retired compound twins. ADR-0076's D11 status line and its section 4 size note are the maintainer's Tier H carry, due now; nothing under `docs/adr/` is touched here.
